notes.title: Chapter 07 part 01 Release!
notes.notes:
Finally, we're ready with another update. It's a small one, but it marks the start of a darker arc in Jeong's story. I'm a bit anxious about how players will react to what's coming up...

We've had multiple delays with this update. It turns out we had a massive bug in our game save system😨. These things happen when it's just me doing almost everything alone.😵 I try to test everything as thoroughly as possible, but testing takes time away from actually making the game. With chapter 06, I rushed it, and that led to the bug.

[h1][b][u]The bug is now fixed, but everyone needs to delete all chapter 06 saves and replay the chapter. Otherwise, the choices you made in chapter 06 won't carry over to chapter 07. I'm tremendously sorry for this inconvenience, and we'll be more careful in the future.😔[/u][/b][/h1]

We also discovered another issue with the save system, and this one will take more time to fix. Currently, some animations can break if the player uses the "load game" feature. I know it sucks, but until we fix it, you can avoid this issue by exiting the game, restarting it, and then loading your save.

The new build should be live on Steam as you read this. I really hope you enjoy this small update. At this point, all the choices you've made begin to really affect where the story goes.

notes.title: I'm back
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I've been gone for almost a year. There were many reasons for my long absence and silence, but in a nutshell: my personal life took a very dark turn, and just when things finally started to brighten—the pandemic began. Overall, it's been a year where everything has felt like a constant struggle, and honestly at some point I really wanted to just give up.

I'm still busy picking up the pieces and gluing them back together. But, I'm feeling so much better and I'm also making steady (yet slow) progress with Yakuza Kiss (chapter 03 has been released today!). This project has always been my "happy place" and I'll keep working on it until it's completed, no matter the constraints on my time and energy.

You've been incredibly supportive and understanding, and I know the constant delays and my bad communication have been frustrating, leading to a lot of you thinking this game has been abandoned.  I tried to hide my problems and wait until I had good news to give you, but I never imagined it would take this long. So, going forward I'm going to do my best to keep you updated even when things aren't going well. As for a project timeline–all I can say is that it's going to take time. I've learned my lesson about how life can change without a moments' notice and false promises only create stress for me and disappointment for you. I'm also working solo on all of the content from music to graphics so everything depends on me, and I'm not willing to sacrifice quality over speed. So please bear with me! I'm trying very hard to make the end result worth the wait.

So once again, I apologize for the wait and the silence, and I'll try to do better in the future. In the meantime, I hope you enjoy the latest chapter of Yakuza Kiss!

Love,
Yume / Pink Potion

notes.title: What Happened?!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32917368/dd9a65154a362d602e53cbdd17f2c56e07cf14e2.jpg[/img]

At the start of this year I wrote a short and happy post about us beginning our tests for chapter 03. I also mentioned that we were going to have our first child in a few months time. At the time, I was utterly oblivious and honestly thought that within a few months time, life would continue as it was before our son... Well, I was wrong. Turns out, the cliché about life never being the same after you have a child–is true.

I will try to spare you all the boring details, but these past 9 months have been a whirlwind of exhaustion and chaos. During this time my own life has been on pause, I've had no choice but to neglect myself, all my work and this project. I'm still struggling, trying to combine my life as a stay-at-home-mom and game dev, but I can see light at the end of the tunnel.

Currently I can only work for short periods of time, mostly during the night. This of course means that Yakuza Kiss is definitely not going to be finished this year, but as bad as I feel about having to delay the project, I'm [b]not[/b] going to give up nor take shortcuts and lower my standards. I will keep chipping away little by little until Yakuza Kiss is finished. I'm immensely thankful to everyone who've offered kind words and encouragement here on Steam and on our Patreon–I couldn't do this without you!

I hope you will forgive the delay and continue to support Yakuza Kiss. I will do my best to make it a game worth the wait.

Happy holidays everyone!
- Yume, Pink Potion

notes.title: July progress update - questions and issues
notes.notes:
Hi Yakuza Kiss players, it's time for another update on our progress!

We've been working hard on chapter 02 and it's about 80% complete. To be honest, I wanted to finish it a lot sooner, but I've had some health issues that have REALLY slowed us down. This week I have barely been able to sit behind a computer. :( This is the risk of running a small team - when I'm sick - things come to a standstill. Fortunately it's nothing serious and I should be up and running soon, but I wanted to let you know what's happening, so that you aren't worried that we've just forgotten about Yakuza Kiss. This project is extremely important to me and there is no way it's not getting finished. From your comments and wonderful messages, I also know that a lot of you are waiting to see what happens next. But please be patient with us and know that as soon as I feel better things will progress much faster!

Now, let's discuss the code. We've managed to make a few upgrades to the game:

- AUTOPLAY/AUTOREAD: you can activate this mode and the text will progress on its own, without you having to click all the time. The game stops progressing when there is a choice to be made, but otherwise you can just sit tight and relax.

We decided to start with this feature since it was one of the most requested features and also because we don't want you to hurt your fingers from all the clicking. :D 

- RAM OPTIMIZATION: This was not a requested feature, but we felt that it was important to optimize the game performance. We've divided the game assets into chapters and we cleanse unused assets from memory. This means that older systems will now run this game a lot smoother.

We might put these updates live soon, but at the latest they will be available with chapter 02.

A lot of you have requested changes to the autosave system. We are currently investigating the possibility of having manual saves. At this point it seems possible that we might be able to do this after all, but I will let you know when we have tested it out.

Lastly, I have some questions for you! I've gathered your feedback and feature requests and I've listed most of them below. Please let us know what you think about them and what you would prioritize. They are all features that we will very likely add to the game, it's just a question of in which order you would like to see them added. We are planning to add a few features per new chapter.

- TEXT OPTIONS: Some players have requested the option to change font sizes and colors (to enhance legibility)

- CG GALLERY: The ability to collect and look at CGs in a separate gallery

- TEXT ARCHIVE: The ability to access a text log (in case you miss something or just want to read it again)

- VIDEO SETTINGS: Change the resolution, fullscreen/window mode, etc.

- HIDE the UI: Hide everything other than the screen image

Feel free to add your own feature request below or in our discussion forum.

As always, thank you so much for the support and love! <3 I'm so happy to have you along for this journey! If you want to follow our progress more closely, you can visit our social media profiles. I love receiving your messages and feedback, so never feel bad about reaching out!

notes.title: After I stepped into Yakuza's world, Yakuza's world seeped into mine
notes.notes:
There's something magical about video games set in the real world. At the intersection of the fantastical and the mundane you get to become the hero of our very own world while taking in some of the most beautiful vistas our planet has to offer, all from the comfort of your couch.

For a long time, I had no particular feeling on the topic, since I had as much of a connection to contemporary Hong Kong or Seattle as I had to Skyrim and Mordor.

That changed on an overcast day in March 2012, when I was living my best life as an exchange student in Japan. I had flown to Okinawa with two friends to escape the surprisingly persistent, wet cold of early March, and on our first day, while we were idly exploring the town of Naha, it began to rain and we ducked into a roofed shopping district.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32917368/feabad364f0102be21d4c3744a3692fe054ae503.png[/img]

Yakuza Kiss chapter 01 is finally about to go live on Steam Early Access. Our tiny team (myself and my partner) has worked its butts off and  the journey to this point has been quite long and hard, but I hope you will join us as we release new chapters, and unfold the story of Jeong Moon and Yuki Yamaguchi!

Yakuza Kiss will remain in Early Access until we have released all upcoming chapters, please feel free to contribute your feedback and feature requests. You can also support us by spreading the word or by becoming a Pink Potion patreon.
